notes: Catalog::gettext(msgid) or ngettext(msgid, plural, n); a small loop fills %s and %d. Not passing: the Russian plural formula is mis-parsed, so ru gets wrong forms.
details: Catalog::parse runs once per fixture, outside the timed call, and the crate has no printf. Its Plural-Forms parser splits at && before ?:, so for the standard Russian formula ngettext(5) returns form 0 instead of 2. English fixtures pass. The variant gettext-force-plural sets ParseOptions::force_plural.
